description:
Configure the 'Populated Places' layer to be visible only when zoomed in (scale 1:20,000,000 or larger).

1. Open the project '/home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/countries_base.gvsproj' which is already loaded.
2. Add the Populated Places shapefile ('/home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp') to the View.
3. Open the Layer Properties for the populated places layer.
4. Configure the scale-dependent visibility so the layer is HIDDEN at global scales and becomes VISIBLE when the scale is 1:20,000,000 or larger (closer).
5. Save the project as '/home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/scale_visibility.gvsproj'.
